scope: United Kingdom Student and Ireland Critical Skills Employment Permit
policy: These records provide field-level primary-source evidence and may only be attached to pathways when they cover the pathway material requirements.

records.claim: For Student visa applications, applicants generally need course-fee funds plus living-cost funds of £1,529 per month in London or £1,171 per month outside London for up to nine months, subject to exemptions and evidence rules.
records.methodology: Direct review of current GOV.UK Student visa financial guidance

records.claim: Ireland's Critical Skills Employment Permit is targeted at highly skilled occupations on the Critical Skills Occupations List and also covers qualifying higher-remuneration roles; applicants generally need a bona-fide Irish employer, relevant qualifications/skills/experience and a job offer of at least two years.
records.sourceAuthority: Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment
records.methodology: Direct review of current Irish government Critical Skills Employment Permit guidance

records.claim: From 1 March 2026, Ireland's Critical Skills Employment Permit remuneration thresholds include €40,909 for qualifying Critical Skills Occupations List roles requiring a relevant degree, €36,849 for qualifying recent graduates and €68,911 for qualifying roles without a relevant degree, subject to the applicable permit rules.
records.sourceAuthority: Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment
records.methodology: Direct review of current Irish government minimum annual remuneration thresholds
